hooks.name: on-loop-active-reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the user about an active on-loop run when the agent stops
hooks.command: if [ -f .on-loop/state.json ]; then phase=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.on-loop/state.json')); print(d.get('phase','UNKNOWN'))" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$phase" != 'COMPLETE' ] && [ "$phase" != 'FAILED' ] && [ -n "$phase" ]; then echo "⚠️  Active on-loop run detected (phase: $phase). Use /on-loop-status to check progress or /on-loop-resume to continue."; fi; fi

hooks.name: on-loop-change-tracker
hooks.description: Tracks file modifications during an active on-loop run
hooks.command: if [ -f .on-loop/state.json ]; then TOOL_NAME="$CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME"; FILE_PATH="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ] && [ -f .on-loop/changes.log ]; then TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); AGENT=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.on-loop/state.json')); print(d.get('current_agent','unknown'))" 2>/dev/null); ACTION='MODIFY'; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = 'Write' ]; then ACTION='CREATE'; fi; echo "[$TIMESTAMP] $AGENT $ACTION $FILE_PATH — tracked by hook" >> .on-loop/changes.log; fi; fi
